The target video is live-action and cinematic, a stark seamless grey studio with soft even key light and a clean neutral palette.
[Shot 1] A vertical medium-full static shot frames <Subject 1> from head to mid-thigh, centred against the grey backdrop, breathing softly, her long curls stirring, smiling brightly at the lens. A glossy wet sheen spreads across her skin and clothing as if under intense heat. Then she begins to melt from the top down: thick glossy drips run from her hair and face down over her shoulders, the white lace camisole slumps and runs, and her beige trousers sag and liquefy. Her smile stays as her features soften and slide, her whole figure sinking lower and lower until she has collapsed into a thick, shining, molten pool spreading across the studio floor, rippling as the last drips fall into it.
